name: imf-weo
title: IMF World Economic Outlook Database
description: Country-level annual macroeconomic data from the IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) database. Covers 45 indicators (GDP, inflation, unemployment, government debt, current account balance, etc.) for approximately 190 countries from 1980 onwards, including IMF staff projections roughly 6 years into the future. Published twice a year (April and October).

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0

resources.name: indicators
resources.description: Reference list of the 45 WEO subject indicators, including their codes, human-readable titles, descriptions, units, and scale.

fields.name: id
fields.description: WEO subject code that uniquely identifies the indicator (e.g. NGDP_R, LUR).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Human-readable indicator name including its unit in parentheses (e.g. 'Gross domestic product, constant prices (Percent change)').

fields.name: description
fields.description: Detailed IMF methodological description of the indicator. May be empty for some indicators.

fields.name: units
fields.description: Unit of measurement for the indicator values (e.g. 'Percent change', 'U.S. dollars', 'National currency').

fields.name: scale
fields.description: Scale multiplier for the reported values (e.g. 'Billions', 'Millions'). Empty when values are not scaled.

resources.name: values
resources.description: Annual indicator values for each country-indicator-year combination. Rows with source value 'n/a' are excluded. A small number of rows contain '--' in the Value field where the source value could not be parsed as a number.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country (e.g. 'USA', 'DEU'). Matches the ISO field in the country resource.

fields.name: Indicator
fields.description: WEO subject code identifying the indicator. Matches the id field in the indicators resource.

fields.name: Year
fields.description: Calendar year of the observation or IMF projection.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: Numeric value of the indicator for the given country and year, expressed in the units and scale defined in the indicators resource. A small number of rows contain '--' where the source value could not be parsed.

resources.name: country
resources.description: Reference table mapping ISO 3-letter country codes to English country names, covering all countries present in the values resource.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: English country name as returned by the IMF DataMapper API.
